title: RapidOCR 本地低内存逐条识别
network_isolation: macOS sandbox-exec deny network*; new base and shared private venv read-only; unavailable isolation blocks execution
registration_boundary: Source-owned fixed profile; no arbitrary runtime, manifest, model or interpreter registration and no automatic profile replacement of existing OCR authorizations.
compatibility: Default m49 remains unchanged. Profile selection is per operation by a known frozen manifest; legacy rendering and new recognition can coexist.
qualification: Single original page9 probe on the same stored PNG stayed below the unchanged observed 1GiB boundary; this is neither an accuracy result nor a whole-report/product-integration guarantee.
license: Same pinned model/code/notices as the private m49 runtime; no model or interpreter bytes changed by this profile.
